subject: Finovo trial launch plan & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <sam.gupta@finovo.com>, Lila Chen <lila@finovo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finovo trial launch plan & acceptance criteria

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get to a tight trial kickoff. Please review and confirm or flag any gaps.

Call recap (short):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference on Finovo's ingestion pipeline and measure latency/cost under a 1M monthly-user scenario.
- Success criteria (draft):
  * 95th pct latency <= 220ms for the standard inference path
  * End-to-end accuracy/quality parity within 3% of your current baseline on the sample eval set
  * No data persistence outside Finovo's VPC; audit logs available for the trial window
- Scope: 4-week trial, integrated with your staging cluster, sample dataset only (PII redacted).

Proposed timeline (kickoff -> readout):
- Week 0 (target kickoff): Mar 22 — onboarding + SSO/KMS alignments
- Week 1: baseline latency & throughput tests; initial model tuning
- Week 2: workload ramp to target QPS; measure cost per 1k tokens
- Week 3: feature parity eval with your eval set; run acceptance tests
- Week 4: final readout + handoff recommendations (target Apr 19)

Owners (proposed):
- Trial owner / program lead: Evelyn Hart (me) — logistics & readout
- Integration & infra: Alex Martinez — network, VPC peering, KMS
- Evaluation & quality: Marissa Cole — eval scenarios, acceptance runbook
- SRE / performance tuning: Rishi Malhotra — batching & latency tuning

Attachments I shared: Finovo_trial_success_criteria_v1.pdf, MAL_action_matrix.xlsx (action matrix stub).

Asks for Finovo team:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or provide adjustments by EOD Friday (Mar 17).
2) Confirm the kickoff date (we proposed Mar 22) and who will own the Finovo-side technical stake (SRE contact + security point).
3) Share any mandatory compliance artifacts we should expect during the trial (SOC2 excerpts, specific IP restrictions).

If that all looks good, we'll circulate a short mutual action plan and a Drive folder with the timeline and acceptance tests.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com


From: Samir Gupta <sam.gupta@finovo.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lila Chen <lila@finovo.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finovo trial launch plan & acceptance criteria

Thanks Evelyn — appreciate the clear recap. Lila and I chatted quickly and this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC2 / security: we will need SOC2 Type II artifacts for the infra stack and a high-level network topology before kickoff. I attached a short doc with our minimal requirements (Finovo_poc_requirements.docx).
2) Timeline: Mar 22 kickoff works for us. Can we target the final readout the week of Apr 23–26? I think Apr 26 as a hard readout is safest.
3) Acceptance tweaks: can we add a cost metric definition — specifically "cost per 1k inference tokens at trial throughput" as part of acceptance?
4) Weekly check-ins: prefer a 30-minute sync every Friday to surface blockers.

Owners from our side:
- Platform lead: Lila Chen (lila@finovo.com) — will own network and access
- Security/Compliance: Samir Gupta (me) — will own artifacts and procurement touchpoints
- Data contact: to be confirmed (we'll loop someone in after kickoff)

We'll review the success criteria PDF and get back with any redlines by EOD Friday.

Samir
Samir Gupta
Director of Platform Engineering, Finovo
sam.gupta@finovo.com

Attachment: Finovo_poc_requirements.docx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <sam.gupta@finovo.com>, Lila Chen <lila@finovo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-17T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finovo trial launch plan & acceptance criteria

Thanks — great, appreciate the quick turn. I've updated the plan to reflect the readout week of Apr 23–26 and added a cost metric line under acceptance: "cost per 1k inference tokens at trial throughput". Attaching the updated timeline (trial_timeline_v2.xlsx).

Consolidated plan & owners (final):
- Kickoff: Mar 22 (30–45m) 
  * Agenda: SSO/KMS checklist, network peering cadence, test-data handoff, success criteria sign-off
- Weekly cadence: Fridays 9:00am PT — 30m status + outstanding action review
- Checkpoints: 
  * End of Week 1: latency baseline report (Alex)
  * End of Week 2: throughput/cost analysis (Rishi + Alex)
  * End of Week 3: functional acceptance report (Marissa)
  * Week 4: final readout & recommendations (Evelyn + Marissa)

Action owners (explicit):
- Alex Martinez: VPC peering, KMS integration, baseline perf tests (deliverable: baseline_report.pdf)
- Rishi Malhotra: config tuning, batching profiles, cost-per-1k-token calc (deliverable: cost_sheet.csv)
- Marissa Cole: eval harness, acceptance scripts, final quality report (deliverable: acceptance_summary.pdf)
- Evelyn Hart: program coordination & readout (deliverable: readout_deck.pptx)

Security artifacts: Samir — thanks for the doc. We'll prepare a short SOC2 excerpt pack and a network diagram before the kickoff; Alex will own collection of any infra proofs we can share.

I've created a Drive folder and the HubSpot mutual action record for the deal (links below). I also added the timeline as trial_timeline_v2.xlsx in the folder. Please review and confirm by EOD Monday (Mar 20) so we can lock the kickoff.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinovoTrial
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-FTV-3789

Thanks everyone — I'll circulate the kickoff invite once we have sign-off.

— Evelyn

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Samir Gupta <sam.gupta@finovo.com>, Lila Chen <lila@finovo.com>
Date: 2028-03-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finovo trial launch plan & acceptance criteria

Quick note from infra: all owners above look good. One small ask — during Week 2 we should include a dedicated "latency baseline with fallback" run so we can exercise the auto-fallback model path and measure tail-latency under failure. I recommend moving one of the Week 2 slots to add a 2-hour window for that test (min impact).

I'll add the baseline/ fallback test to the timeline in Drive. Will also draft the network diagram for Samir by Mon morning.

— Alex
